name: app-shell
title: AppShell widget wrapping StatefulNavigationShell with Scaffold and AppBottomNav

properties: showAppBar: bool (default true) — when true, renders AppAppBar above branch content

conventions_reminder: Double quotes on all string literals
Top-of-file doc comment explaining purpose and behavior
acceptance_criteria: Public API: AppShell({required StatefulNavigationShell navigationShell, required List<AppBottomNavItem> items, bool showAppBar = true})
Renders bottom nav with correct selected state via navigationShell.currentIndex
onTap calls navigationShell.goBranch with initialLocation reset behavior (initialLocation: index == navigationShell.currentIndex)
When showAppBar is true, AppAppBar is rendered with title from items[navigationShell.currentIndex].label
Body is Column with AppAppBar (conditionally) and Expanded(navigationShell)
completion_summary: Implemented AppShell as a StatelessWidget wrapping StatefulNavigationShell with a Scaffold. Renders optional AppAppBar (title from current nav item label) and AppBottomNav with correct selected index. onTap uses goBranch with initialLocation reset behavior.
